intro.fr: Laika: Aged Through Blood se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Laika: Aged Through Blood can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Brainwash Gang sort Laika: Aged Through Blood en 2023.
text.en: Brainwash Gang releases Laika: Aged Through Blood in 2023.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub ItsSeras/Laika-Aged-Through-Blood-Archipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de Laika: Aged Through Blood.
text.en: The GitHub repository ItsSeras/Laika-Aged-Through-Blood-Archipelago, home of the Laika: Aged Through Blood APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v-0.1.0 (préversion).
text.en: The first version, v-0.1.0 (pre-release), is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v-0.1.7, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (8 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v-0.1.7 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (8 versions released).

text.fr: Laika: Aged Through Blood figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Laika: Aged Through Blood is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
